sections.content: My current assumption is that there is nothing particularly noteworthy about this capability? Many formats can achieve this?

sections.label: Context
sections.content: Said after the lab result that SRS packages generate a relational schema in both directions (vignette 03218e1c, srs-context research note a0b5e1fe), while asking for the SQL projection to be added to srs-projection. A theory about the work's significance: that schema-to-database generation is commonplace and not a differentiator.
